### PNC — Sequential EPS improves despite weaker reported revenue

**Reported GAAP diluted EPS increased to $4.97 from $4.81 in 2Q26**, while adjusted EPS increased from $4.85 to $5.09. The latter excludes integration costs and significant items from both periods [B0041–B0043].

**EPS drivers:** Third-quarter results included $36 million of integration costs and a net $25 million of adverse Visa-related items. Combined, these reduced after-tax earnings by $48 million, or $0.12 per share. Excluding these items provides a clearer view of underlying profitability [B0068].

**Revenue and margin:** GAAP NII rose $99 million to $4,206 million, supported by commercial loan growth and earning-asset yields. NIM slipped 2 basis points to 2.94%. Reported noninterest income decreased to $2,356 million, while expenses fell substantially to $3,751 million. Adjusted expenses declined from $3,837 million to $3,724 million [B0029, B0094, B0058, B0032, B0034, B0036].

**Credit:** Provision was essentially unchanged at $189 million, while net charge-offs rose to $257 million, equivalent to an annualized 0.28%. ACL coverage was 1.42% [B0038, B0052, B0260, B0053].

**Capital and returns:** CET1 was 9.8%, reported ROTCE was 18.28%, and tangible book value was $107.64 per share. Common share repurchases approximated $600 million [B0061, B0056, B0046, B0117].

**Guidance:** Management anticipated fourth-quarter repurchase activity approximating the third quarter [B0118].

**Investment thesis:** Modestly positive. Underlying EPS and expense improvements support the case, although margin pressure and elevated charge-offs remain areas to monitor.
